e.title: LAB Insurance Sales (.NET)
e.summary: .NET 8 微服务保险销售系统参考（1938★）：EF Core/MediatR/Marten/Ocelot/JWT 的完整微服务样例
e.body: LAB Insurance Sales Portal（asc-lab/dotnetcore-microservices-poc，1938★）是极简保险销售系统的微服务架构完整示例：.NET 8 + Entity Framework Core + MediatR + Marten + Eureka + Ocelot + JWT + RawRabbit + NHibernate + Polly + ElasticSearch——销售/报价/保单等域的微服务拆分、API 网关、消息队列与容错示例。对 RIAA：保险系统的微服务架构教学参考（.NET 路线，1938★ 被广泛用于微服务课程）——与 [[titanium-insurance-core]]（Java/中文）、[[aws-serverless-claims-eda]]（AWS 无服务器）对照不同技术栈的保险系统架构；配合 [[insurancepro-crm]]（前台 CRM）理解分层。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：.NET 8 微服务保险销售系统样例（EF/MediatR/Marten/Ocelot/JWT），1938★
e.summary_en: .NET 8 microservice insurance-sales reference (1938★): complete microservices sample with EF Core/MediatR/Marten/Ocelot/JWT
e.summary_hk: .NET 8 微服務保險銷售系統參考（1938★）：EF Core/MediatR/Marten/Ocelot/JWT 的完整微服務樣例
e.body_en: LAB Insurance Sales Portal (asc-lab/dotnetcore-microservices-poc, 1938★) is a complete microservices example of a very simplified insurance sales system: .NET 8 + Entity Framework Core + MediatR + Marten + Eureka + Ocelot + JWT + RawRabbit + NHibernate + Polly + ElasticSearch — microservice decomposition across sales/quote/policy domains, API gateway, message queue and resilience patterns. For RIAA: a microservices-architecture teaching reference for insurance systems (the .NET route; 1938★, widely used in microservices courses) — compare the different tech-stack architectures with [[titanium-insurance-core]] (Java/Chinese) and [[aws-serverless-claims-eda]] (AWS serverless); pair with [[insurancepro-crm]] (front-office CRM) to understand layering.
e.body_hk: LAB Insurance Sales Portal（asc-lab/dotnetcore-microservices-poc，1938★）是極簡保險銷售系統的微服務架構完整示例：.NET 8 + Entity Framework Core + MediatR + Marten + Eureka + Ocelot + JWT + RawRabbit + NHibernate + Polly + ElasticSearch——銷售/報價/保單等域的微服務拆分、API 網關、消息隊列與容錯示例。對 RIAA：保險系統的微服務架構教學參考（.NET 路線，1938★ 被廣泛用於微服務課程）——與 [[titanium-insurance-core]]（Java/中文）、[[aws-serverless-claims-eda]]（AWS 無伺服器）對照不同技術棧的保險系統架構；配合 [[insurancepro-crm]]（前台 CRM）理解分層。
